title: Software Engineer II (SDE 2) - Backend
description:
* Title: Software Engineer II (SDE 2) - (Backend - Golang)
* Department: Technology / Core Platform Engineering
* Location: Bangalore Corporate Office
* Employment Type: Full Time
* Experience: 3 – 5 years Experience

**The Opportunity**
Nudge is building India’s ultimate commerce rewards platform. Users earn rewards by scanning and uploading shopping bills, linking accounts like Gmail or consumer apps (e.g., Swiggy, Zepto), and playing casual games on the platform.
  
  
Behind that experience sit Go microservices handling bill ingestion, transaction parsing, fraud checks and real-time reward distribution. We are looking for an
**SDE 2 (Backend, Golang)**
who can own features and services end to end: take a problem from design doc to production, and keep it healthy once it ships.
  
  
You will work closely with senior engineers on architecture, while independently owning the services and features you build.
  
  
**What You’ll Achieve**
**Own Services End to End**

* Design, build and ship Go microservices and RESTful APIs for bill processing, third-party app integrations and gaming backends.
* Write design docs for the features you own, and take them from design through rollout and monitoring.

**Build for Concurrency & Correctness**

* Implement reward and ledger flows that stay consistent under concurrent uploads, retries and partial failures.
* Apply idempotency, locking and rate-limiting patterns to prevent double-crediting and abuse.
* Design schemas, indexes and caching strategies for heavy read/write workloads on PostgreSQL and Redis.

**Integrate with the Outside World**

* Build reliable integrations with third-party platforms, handling auth, retries, rate limits and messy data.
* Work on event-driven pipelines that move user activity from ingestion to reward.

**Raise the Engineering Bar**

* Review code with care and help junior engineers through pairing, reviews and clear feedback.
* Improve test coverage, tooling and the maintainability of the services you touch.

**Production Ownership**

* Own the uptime and performance of your services: logging, metrics, alerts and dashboards.
* Take part in on-call, debug production issues and contribute to postmortems.

**Build Faster with AI**

* Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to design, build, test and debug faster, while owning the quality of everything you ship.
* Help the team use AI well: share workflows, set review standards for AI-generated code, and spot where AI can speed up our engineering.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3–5 years of backend engineering experience building and running production systems.
* Strong hands-on production experience in Golang (mandatory), including goroutines, channels, context and concurrency patterns.
* Solid grasp of microservices, RESTful API design and event-driven systems.
* Good working knowledge of PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query tuning) and Redis (caching, distributed locks).
* Experience with Docker and CI/CD; exposure to Kubernetes and cloud platforms (GCP/AWS).
* A track record of owning a service or major feature from design to production, not just implementing tickets.
* Strong debugging skills across logs, metrics and profiles.
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools in day-to-day work, with the judgement to review, test and correct AI-generated code before it ships.
* Startup mindset: high ownership, comfort with ambiguity, and real drive to build something from early stage.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Real Ownership Early: Own services that sit on the critical path of rewards for millions of transactions.
* Hard, Interesting Problems: Concurrency, ledger consistency, OCR pipelines and third-party integrations, not CRUD.
* Growth to Senior: Work directly with senior engineers and founders on architecture, with a clear path to Senior Engineer.
* Product-First Culture: A fast-paced team where shipping and user impact come first.
* AI-First Workflow: Modern AI coding tools are part of how we build, every day.

title: Engineering Lead - AI
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology | CBS Technology | Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI & Automation**
**Job Summary:**
The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
  
  
Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
  
  
**The ideal candidate will possess:**

* Extensive, hands-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and data-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI-first architectures, including LLM-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human-in-the-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.

**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Engineering Ownership & Delivery Accountability

+ Own end-to-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:

- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.

* Hands-on GenAI & AI Systems Engineering


+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production-grade GenAI systems, including:

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human-in-the-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder-to-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:

- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.

* Architecture & Engineering Standards

+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:

- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.

* AI Platform Engineering & MLOps / LLMOps

+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:

- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.

* Team Leadership & Capability Building

+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI & Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:

- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.

* Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

+ Partner closely with:

- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.

**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**

* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go-live, including reliability and cost optimization.

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
**real, reliable, and scalable systems**
—not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
  
  
**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in Python, Java, C#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API-driven, cloud-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.

**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**

* Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including:

+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:

+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.

**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**

* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.

**Detailed Responsibilities:**

* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.

**Other Requirements:**

* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams

**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**

* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience

**Experience:**

* 10+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3+ Years in a global operations environment

**Certification Requirements:**

* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Software Engineering Intern - Client (Mobile)
description:
* Title: Software Engineering Intern - (Client / Mobile - Android, iOS)
* Department: Technology / Mobile Engineering
* Location: Bangalore Corporate Office
* Employment Type: Internship
* Eligibility: Final-year students or recent graduates (B.Tech / B.E. / MCA or equivalent)

**The Opportunity**
Nudge is building India’s ultimate commerce rewards platform. For most users, Nudge
*is*
the mobile app: it is where they scan shopping bills, link accounts like Gmail or Swiggy and Zepto, play games, and watch their rewards grow.
  
  
Our Android and iOS apps share a codebase built with
**Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP)**
and
**Compose Multiplatform**
. As a
**Client Intern**
, you will build features in this app alongside our mobile engineers, with a mentor reviewing your work.
  
  
You don’t need prior KMP experience. If you have built apps on any mobile platform and want to go deep on modern cross-platform development, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You’ll Achieve**
**Build Features Users Touch Every Day**

* Build screens and flows for bill scanning, account linking, rewards and in-app games.
* Turn designs into polished, responsive UI with smooth animations and clear states (loading, empty, error).

**Work Across the Mobile Stack**

* Integrate with backend REST APIs, handle networking, caching and offline behaviour.
* Work with device capabilities like the camera, permissions, notifications and deep links.
* Learn how shared Kotlin code runs on both Android and iOS, and where platform-specific code is needed.

**Ship with Quality**

* Write tests, profile for performance and fix crashes and UI bugs.
* Go through code reviews and learn the release process from build to Play Store and App Store.

**Build Faster with AI**

* Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to build screens, write tests and debug faster, while understanding and owning every line you ship.
* Use AI to explore the codebase, turn designs into UI scaffolding, and prototype ideas quickly.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Hands-on experience building apps on at least one mobile platform: Android (Kotlin/Java), iOS (Swift), Flutter or React Native.
* Kotlin experience, or a clear willingness to learn it fast. Exposure to Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI or KMP is a strong plus.
* Understanding of app architecture basics (MVVM or similar), app lifecycle and state management.
* Comfort consuming REST/JSON APIs and handling async work (coroutines, async/await or similar).

**Senior Technical Release Manager**

**Technical Release Governor**
in a complex hybrid environment consisting of both
**multi-tenant**
products and
**multi-instance**
siloed environments.

**carrier customer**
base, we are looking to adopt best of the breed release practices. You will ensure releases are delivered with quality, predictability, and efficiency while bridging the gap between engineering, QA, product, and client support teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Release Lifecycle Leadership:**
Own and manage the end-to-end release lifecycle for all production deployments, including core platform production updates and customer-specific customizations. Define, document, and enforce
**release management processes and standards**
. Create and maintain the
**release calendar**
, ensuring transparency and alignment across teams.
  
  
**Technical Gatekeeping:**
Conduct deep-dive release readiness reviews. You will audit "Release Manifests" by validating steps such as SQL migrations or PDF template migrations, Temporal workflow versioning, Kafka schemas, and AWS resource configurations. A good overall understanding of deployment architecture in AWS is essential for this role.
  
  
**Environment Governance:**
Manage "Instance Parity" across our
**AWS**
multi-instance architecture to prevent "Environmental Drift" and ensure customer-specific secrets and variables match our global standards.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Orchestration:**
Facilitate formal "Go/No-Go" decisions by tracking a global checklist that includes technical and non-technical readiness.
  
  
**Risk Mitigation:**
Identify, document, and mitigate technical sequencing risks (e.g., database locks or stateful workflow conflicts) associated with production releases.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Monitor release performance, generate and provide metrics and reports and drive the transition from manual coordination to
**Automated Production Quality Gates**
within our release pipelines.

**10+ years of overall technical experience**
, with a background in software engineering, SRE, or backend operations.
  
  
**5+ years of direct release management experience**
in a complex, enterprise hybrid SaaS environment (Multi-tenant & Multi-instance).

Expert-level knowledge of
**AWS**
(EKS, RDS, Secrets Manager, IAM, S3, MSK) and the ability to audit infrastructure-level configurations.

Demonstrated familiarity with
**Typescript**
,
**PHP, Go-lang, and Node.js**
ecosystems. You must understand the deployment nuances of each.
  
  
**Modern Orchestration:**
Hands-on experience or strong knowledge of
**Temporal**
(stateful workflows) and
**Kafka**
(event streaming). You understand the risks of deploying to "in-flight" asynchronous processes.
  
  
**Database Proficiency:**
Strong proficiency in
**MySQL and Postgres**
, specifically in auditing complex migration scripts and data sequencing.
  
  
**Containerization Mastery:**
Deep understanding of
**Kubernetes (K8s)**
manifest auditing and deployment patterns (Canary, Blue-Green, or Rolling Updates).
  
  
**Communication & Gravitas:**
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the professional authority to enforce discipline and halt releases if technical or business criteria are not met.

Experience in the insurance or financial services domain (or other regulated industries).
  
  
Knowledge of security, compliance (SOC2/ISO), or audit processes as they relate to release operations.
  
  
Experience with

tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  
  
Familiarity with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles such as Error Budgets and SLIs/SLOs.

title: GDS Microsoft Frontier Innovation Solution Architect - Associate Director - India
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Title: GDS Microsoft Frontier Innovation Solution Architect - Associate Director - India**
**The opportunity**
The Microsoft Alliance is one of EY’s most strategic ecosystem relationships, helping clients accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation, security and emerging technologies. Within this agenda, the Frontier Innovation team brings together EY’s industry knowledge and Microsoft’s technology capabilities to shape scalable, market-relevant solutions that respond to priority client needs and create new growth opportunities across global markets.
  
  
We are seeking a senior, highly collaborative, technology-led and business-oriented Solution Architect / Strategist to provide global support to the Microsoft Frontier Innovation agenda. This role will help shape architecture direction, solution strategy, technical design standards, readiness criteria and scalable build approaches for prioritized Frontier Innovation initiatives. The individual will be expected to translate innovation concepts, alliance priorities and market opportunities into structured, technically sound and commercially relevant solution designs that can progress from ideation to build, activation and scale.
  
  
This role is designed for an experienced professional who can connect business strategy with practical technology architecture and provide senior-level direction across complex, matrixed stakeholder groups. You will work closely with global alliance leadership, Microsoft stakeholders, regional teams, solution owners, service line and sector teams, architects, engineering teams, sales, marketing and GDS teams to ensure Frontier Innovation solutions are technically feasible, commercially relevant, governance-ready and positioned for market activation.
  
  
This is an opportunity for a senior professional who enjoys working at the intersection of AI, cloud architecture, Microsoft technologies, alliances, solution design, global innovation and go-to-market growth. The role offers the opportunity to influence how EY and Microsoft shape, mature and scale the next generation of Frontier Innovation solutions across global priority markets.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Provide senior solution architecture leadership and strategic technical direction**

* Lead architecture direction for the global Frontier Innovation portfolio, ensuring each solution has a clear strategic intent, technical scope, design assumptions, dependencies, integration considerations, delivery pathway and ownership model.
* Translate global market priorities, client challenges and business requirements into pragmatic solution strategies, architecture choices and scalable implementation approaches.
* Develop architecture blueprints, solution patterns, design principles and reusable components that support consistent solution build, adaptation and scale across regions.
* Partner with solution owners, architects and technology stakeholders to validate technical feasibility, scalability, security, integration readiness, commercialization potential and operational handover requirements.
* Ensure key technical and strategic decisions are supported by clear documentation, rationale, ownership, risks, assumptions and aligned next steps.

**Shape AI, cloud and Microsoft solution strategy and architecture focus**

* Shape the strategy, architecture and design of solutions powered by Microsoft technologies, including Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud and AI Platforms, Security, data, automation and emerging technology priorities.
* Evaluate Microsoft technology capabilities, platform patterns and architecture options to identify practical opportunities for global Frontier Innovation solutions.
* Build visibility into AI-enabled solution concepts, including use cases, accelerators, demos, client-zero examples, architecture artifacts, solution assets and go-to-market readiness.
* Promote responsible and practical adoption of AI by ensuring solution architecture discussions consider business value, risk, governance, data requirements, privacy, security, compliance and adoption needs.
* Translate complex Microsoft architecture and technology themes into compelling, business-friendly narratives that can be used with global leadership, regional teams, sales and broader stakeholder groups.

**Strengthen solution design governance and technical assurance**

* Support solution design reviews, architecture walkthroughs and technical governance checkpoints across prioritized global Frontier Innovation initiatives.
* Assess architecture readiness across key areas including solution scope, integration approach, data flow, security, scalability, performance, support model and operational handover.
* Coordinate with alliance, technology, solution, delivery and commercial teams to maintain visibility across technical decisions, dependencies, risks and required actions.
* Help assess whether solutions are progressing toward intended outcomes, including maturity, activation readiness, adoption potential, implementation feasibility and global market relevance.
* Prepare concise, executive-ready leadership summaries on architecture status, technical risks, design decisions required, readiness gaps and recommended actions.

**Lead global stakeholder alignment and senior collaboration**

* Act as a senior connector across global alliance leadership, Microsoft field teams, regional stakeholders, solution owners, architects, service line leaders, sector stakeholders, sales, marketing and GDS support teams.
* Support alignment across business, technology, delivery and go-to-market stakeholders so global priorities are translated into executable solution architecture actions.
* Coordinate solution design workshops, architecture forums and leadership check-ins to ensure progress is visible, decision points are clear and follow-through is disciplined.
* Proactively identify stakeholder gaps, ownership ambiguities, technical dependencies and cross-team risks that could impact solution build, readiness or market activation across regions.
* Build trusted relationships across a complex global and regional stakeholder network, influencing senior outcomes through clarity, structure, credibility and practical problem solving.

**Drive strategic architecture reporting, insights and readiness tracking**

* Develop and maintain architecture trackers, solution readiness summaries and executive views that provide clear visibility into global Frontier Innovation solution health and technical progress.
* Monitor key indicators related to solution maturity, architecture readiness, integration dependencies, technical risk, asset completeness, activation readiness and business outcomes.
* Analyze trends across solution architecture activities and provide practical recommendations to improve solution design, governance, reuse and go-to-market impact.
* Prepare materials for leadership reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews and other global governance forums.
* Use data, architecture inputs and stakeholder feedback to tell a clear executive story on where solutions are progressing well, where support is required and where leadership decisions are needed.

**Enable global Frontier Innovation activation readiness and market outcomes**

* Work with sales, marketing, regional and solution teams to support activation planning for prioritized Frontier Innovation solutions.
* Track readiness of key technical and solution assets such as demos, architecture diagrams, credentials, case studies, sales collateral, enablement material, marketplace content and client-facing narratives.
* Help identify opportunities to scale successful Microsoft-powered solutions across priority accounts, sectors, service lines and regions.
* Support coordination of global and region-specific enablement activities so client-facing teams understand the solution architecture, value proposition and activation pathway.
* Ensure architecture-level insights and lessons learned are fed back into solution teams to strengthen commercialization, adoption, reuse and governance discipline.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
We are looking for someone who brings a strong balance of technical depth, solution architecture discipline, strategic thinking, senior stakeholder influence and execution orientation. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across leadership audiences, evolving Microsoft technologies and complex global solution landscapes while maintaining a practical focus on scalable design, decision clarity, execution readiness and measurable outcomes.
  
  

* Deep solution architecture, technical design and architecture governance experience, preferably across cloud, AI, data, automation, security or digital transformation solution portfolios.
* Ability to translate global business priorities, client needs and market opportunities into scalable Microsoft-powered solution architectures and practical implementation approaches.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft solution areas and ecosystem themes, including Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud and AI Platforms, Security, data, automation and emerging technologies.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex architecture and technology information for senior leadership, business stakeholders and client-facing teams.
* Ability to influence without authority and build alignment across senior, matrixed alliance, technology, delivery, regional and commercial teams.
* Strong analytical capability with experience developing architecture artifacts, readiness trackers, executive summaries, technical narratives, decision papers and governance materials.
* High attention to detail, strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, ambiguous and globally matrixed environment.
* Curiosity, adaptability and a genuine interest in innovation-led growth, responsible AI and Microsoft technology transformation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience in solution architecture, technology consulting, enterprise architecture, cloud architecture, digital transformation, innovation management, technology program enablement or strategic technology operations.
* Experience designing, shaping or advising on complex cross-functional technology solutions across regional or global stakeholder groups.
* Experience with architecture governance, technical design documentation, solution readiness tracking, architecture reviews, risk identification and performance management.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience preparing executive-ready materials, leadership updates and business-friendly technical narratives.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify technical risks early and drive structured follow-through in a fast-paced global environment.
* Experience working with technology-enabled transformation, cloud, AI, automation, data, security or digital solution portfolios.
* Graduate or postgraduate degree in technology, engineering, computer science, business, innovation management or a related discipline.

**Preferred Experience**

* Strong exposure to Microsoft ecosystem programs and solution areas, including Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud and AI Platforms, Security, data, automation or related technologies.
* Experience in alliance management, co-sell motions, Frontier Innovation programs, solution strategy, marketplace offerings or technology partner ecosystems.
* Experience supporting global, multi-region or cross-market business priorities in a professional services, consulting, technology or global delivery environment.
* Experience working with architecture patterns, solution blueprints, reusable assets, demos, accelerators, solution readiness frameworks or technical governance models.
* Experience engaging senior business and technology stakeholders to shape priorities, resolve design trade-offs and drive decisions across global programs.
* Understanding solution commercialization, go-to-market activation, architecture governance, innovation lifecycle management and market readiness.
* Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, security, compliance and governance considerations in solution design and technology activation.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that plays a vital role in advancing EY’s growth strategy. Working across locations including Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK, GDS teams collaborate with EY service lines, geographies and sectors to deliver high-quality work for clients around the world. In GDS, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, collaborate with diverse teams and build capabilities across an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, technology and insights that support long-term career growth.
  
  

* Continuous learning: Develop the mindset, skills and confidence to adapt, grow and navigate what comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: Access the tools, flexibility and support to make a meaningful impact in the way that works best for you.
* Transformative leadership: Gain insights, coaching and experiences that help you grow into the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: Be valued for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
